summary: Karooooo Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing an interim cash dividend of USD 1.50 per ordinary share and the date of its annual general meeting. The filing provides dividend currency conversion and tax considerations for South African resident shareholders, including a conversion rate of USD1: ZAR16.41549 and details on South African dividend tax. The record date is July 17, 2026, with payment on July 27, 2026 for NASDAQ and July 20, 2026 for JSE. This is a routine dividend announcement and meeting notice, not a special situation.
